subject: Quick Update
body:
Hi Shubham,

 

Just a few hours ago, we released [a nice recap video](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/Ol_9SslvSvxM) from this year's EU-Startups Summit, and I thought I'd share it with you. :)

 

By the way: Have you already marked your calendar for next year's edition? In case you missed it, next year's [EU-Startups Summit](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/KGmAMJj7V6Lh) will be held on May 7-8, again in beautiful Malta!

 

In the meantime, we're currently brainstorming about how to further optimise our editorial output, so we're curious to learn what your preferred channels are for consuming startup-related content? You can let us know [here](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFS25jXzQKIfNVPNoRQ2c/5tIASVgbXiez). 

 

And we're also curious which areas of tech innovation you are mainly interested in. Unfortunately LinkedIn polls only allow for 4 options, but please feel free to state your other areas of interest in the comments [here](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfy8RYb2WYemL1hJZkJE9z8/MD1-R-Sj93nX).

 

Last but not least: In case you or someone you know is working on ClimateTech, I wanted to share that tomorrow is the deadline for the [Amazon Sustainability Accelerator](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng01R56LV7tENO17k6o0tve/JbOJooNaYw_w), which is supporting startups in energy, waste, and water innovation. Selected teams will get expert support, $10K in AWS credits, and the chance to pilot their tech with Amazon. The hybrid programme runs from 8 Sept. to 3 October.

 

Have a great week!

 

Sunny greetings,

Thomas

body:
Hi Shubham,

 

Remember when I mentioned in the newsletter four weeks ago that the AC in our EU-Startups office broke down? Well, it is still not fixed. I could tell you a long story about this (a drama), but instead, let's focus on some more light topics, like good news, insights and opportunities related to startups in Europe! :) Here you go:

 

🔒 **Is your startup aiming to shape the future of insurance?** Grupo Ageas Portugal is excited to announce the launch of the 3rd edition of [Ageas Insure](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/dbS8814XP2gp), its open innovation program designed to foster collaboration with startups worldwide. The program aims to develop, test and scale cutting-edge solutions that create value for the company, its customers, and society.

 

💸 **Nebeus launches crowdfunding campaign:** This is your chance to back a startup bridging crypto and traditional finance. 🦾 **AI, Quantum Computin****g & Robotics****:**

🧠**AI meets Sales:** Looking to scale your sales without scaling your team? This week, we published a curated list of 10 European startups using AI to optimise the sales process! From voice agents and CRM automation to smart lead generation. [Check out the full list here.](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng9SOhcsNy3UZBcAZvHwbeE/fXVas20MqGfH)

 

📅 **Innovation Park returns to ISE 2026:** Are you building cutting-edge solutions in AV, media, or systems integration? Innovation Park is back at ISE 2026, offering 144 startups a prime spot to showcase their tech, pitch to investors, and meet the industry’s key players. [Apply now to be part of the action](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6vLwtrlX4zfDnxx1VYGWkZ0/l17J2--d4o_L).

 

🧬 **HealthTech & MedTech:**


- London-based[ ScienceMachine](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7390w51tATKzY7kAIRNmSB8/1QOk66K9T3zx) raised €2.9 million for BioTech analysis solutions

- French scale-up [Ciloa](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Ij90VYbLQgX2RKRsDcHrPO/SEENZuhrjkb-) raised €6.5 million to develop exosome therapy for metabolic diseases. 
- Swiss MedTech firm [Comphya](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7QWD2ioxQuMImb7af6jXZ1W/8ohzMaS90YtY) just got €8 million in funding to treat erectile dysfunction with a new neurostimulator. 
- Amsterdam-based [Biotech Booster](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7YJH4w5JWO24WkujRzqnGde/yhLVjOTjCchK) received €196.4 million to bring Dutch medical innovations to market. 
- Netherlands-based [plasmacure](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7g6L79LfbrhqGuhsEsy2yFm/Fllbfsm7Smje) raised €6 million (plus US market financing) for a new wound treatment device.

🌿**GreenTech & Energy:**


- Milan-based [Tulum Energy](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ83TXDn8jsIj9VO5IbYJo56A/4dxG3w2AsHqZ) raised €22.9 million to scale its low-carbon hydrogen production tech. 
- Helsinki-based [Donut Lab](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6vNptOGq3YtfqKGpfulJUVW/Kb2MhWrq8-IS) raised €25 million to develop electric solutions for land, sea and air. 
- Paris-based investment club [Keenest](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ73AtvbXC92ZRaU3ySnsZC7e/d_dn3CkxQY8s) invested over €5 million in sustainable economy ventures. 
 

📱 **European Founders & Investors on TikTok:**Think TikTok’s just for dance trends? Think again. A new wave of European founders, investors, and operators are using the platform to break down business, growth, and funding. From fundraising tips to startup strategy, here are [20 TikTok voices](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7AxxxonYEWFDKdr7Fgzotjm/PrYiR5xvB4sO) worth following.

 

🎧 **EU-Startups Podcast:**This week, our Podcast Director Marcin had Erika De Santi, the Co-founder and Chief Experience Officer at WeRoad, on the show. Wanna learn from the growth journey of one of Europe's fastest growing travel startups? [Tune in](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Il2023uJzuz4neG2a74bLu/lwPfu6NryN6_)!

That's it for today Shubham, I'm now calling the AC technician again to see if we can still get this sorted before the end of the summer. Wish me luck! :)

 

Sunny greetings,

Thomas

body:
Hi Shubham,

 

Before you enter into your well-deserved weekend, I'd like to share with you a quick EU-Startups Update with some news, insights and opportunities that might spark your interest:

 

**📰****Startup Media:******While TechCrunch Europe shut down (or paused), there are many alternatives that are very alive and kicking. [Here is an overview](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/fezNED2dqd1x) regarding the four leading media brands that specifically focus on startups in Europe.

 

🎧 **EU-Startups Podcast:** This week, [we talked to Carles Reina](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/zSIjpSHEKCKd), the first investor and go-to-market strategist at ElevenLabs - one of the world's fastest growing AI Audio research and deployment companies. Carles shares what it really takes to scale an AI startup, and much more! By the way, recently we also had [Tim Draper](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFS25jXzQKIfNVPNoRQ2c/rbWxgufThyWf) on the show.

- London-based [Metaview](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng1uQbbeTh7gPkKvuTIndsA/Tgx-cTZ4CAPN) just raised €30.1 million to transform recruitment with an AI platform that streamlines interviews and talent insights.

🎇 **From Rooftop Chats to Real Investments:** The EU-Startups Summit has become a true engine for connections that matter. A few days ago, our News Editor, David Cendon Garcia, [highlighted a few of the deals and connections](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng9SOhcsNy3UZBcAZvHwbeE/2dbqgaNbcyDZ) that emerged from the recent editions in Malta.

 

💶 **Fresh VC Funds:**


- Stockholm-based [Norrsken Foundation](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6vLwtrlX4zfDnxx1VYGWkZ0/klkdjCNIFx87) committed €300 million to fund 'AI for good' startups working in climate, health, education, and more 
- Prague-based [KAYA VC](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7390w51tATKzY7kAIRNmSB8/E2qzZqw8SMHJ) just closed a €70 million fund to back more founders across Central and Eastern Europe. 
- Warsaw-based[ Movens Capital](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Aw4yIIFFx0lIHXJ5KV29nG/YRXZu4brVPd7) launched a €60 million fund to support CEE tech startups from pre-seed to Series A+. 
- Bologna-based[ Zanichelli Editore](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Ij90VYbLQgX2RKRsDcHrPO/Y1wyGizyjSL9) launched a €60 million EdTech fund to drive innovation in education and human potential. 
 

**📊****Tier 2 Social Media Platforms:** We just asked our LinkedIn followers which of the following platforms they use most. TikTok, X, Threads, or Bluesky. [Here](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7QWD2ioxQuMImb7af6jXZ1W/tsW32wDFNS_T) are the results. By the way, [EU-Startups is now also on TikTok](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7YJH4w5JWO24WkujRzqnGde/EqI7KL9G_N9y), and if we hit 1k followers there by the end of the summer, we'll perform an awesome TikTok dance for you. Promised! :)

 

🏆 **FutureTravel Pitch Competition:** Applications for the big Pitch Competition at this year's FutureTravel Summit (October 30, Barcelona) will be closing by the end of this week. Ten early-stage travel and hospitality startups will compete for a prize package worth €355K. [Apply now!](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7g6L79LfbrhqGuhsEsy2yFm/7ixepaY5gfS2)

 

**✈️ EU-Startups on Tour:**Last Friday, our Events & Partnerships Director Anastasiia represented EU-Startups at the [500 Eurasia Batch 8 Demo Day](https://4ntll.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7ntP9Mc1hLNc14V11m5Ifru/fGRcusALGkvK) (Tbilisi, Georgia); and on August 27-28 our Head of Content, Antonio, will represent EU-Startups at TechBBQ in Copenhagen.

 

Enjoy the upcoming weekend Shubham, and stay humble, healthy and hydrated. :)

 

Sunny greetings,

Thomas

body:
Hi Shubham,

 

I hope you're having a great week so far! To make it even better, here are some fresh opportunities, insights and news related to startups and venture capital in Europe:

 

🥗 **Future Foods Lab:******Applications are now open for Nomad Foods’ Future Foods Lab, a bold new Venture Clienting program launched in partnership with global innovation network Innoget. The program invites startups with market-ready solutions to tackle key business challenges, with the potential to pilot and scale across Europe. [Register](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/j5Sz3BHbqnUh) for their upcoming webinar, learn more, and apply!

 

💊 **Health & BioTech Innovators: **


- Bulgarian HealthTech provider [Blue Longevity Clinic](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/bjlqsA5GkVD-) raised €2 million to help you live longer. 
- Estonian BioTech developer [ÄIO](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFS25jXzQKIfNVPNoRQ2c/cun654j_wAJB) secured €1 million to create greener alternatives for cosmetics. 
- Are you curious about HealthTech innovations? Make sure to subscribe to our weekly [HealthHack newsletter](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfy8RYb2WYemL1hJZkJE9z8/ReFAe_va3hZL). 
- Swiss BioTech innovator [ASTRA Therapeutics](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng01R56LV7tENO17k6o0tve/_WgRfPETa7lS) today announced €8.3 million in fresh funding to advance precision Parasiticides for animal health. 
 

🧠 **AI Funding Rounds of the Week:**


- Stockholm-based[ Lovable](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng1uQbbeTh7gPkKvuTIndsA/sc3xl7CetNVU) has just become the fastest-growing software company ever, skyrocketing to $100 million ARR in just 8 months. 
- London-based[ Bitfount](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng3nQ86xSGM8S6ek4pnaNog/WDuAUZPiAjAb) raised €6.8 million to break down clinical research data silos with its federated AI network. 
- London-based [Magentic](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng5gPecGQpaaUSyYFCIN7lC/BFQcOVLCDcfK) secured €4.6 million to scale enterprise automation by deploying AI agents into the supply chain. 
- Stuttgart-based [Makersite](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng7ZPB7ZPOp2WpIMPYn9rhi/KCac8ce4zc75) raised €60 million to accelerate product sustainability through AI during the design process 
 

🎯 **Ready to fast-track compliance** for SOC 2, ISO 27001, or GDPR? Join Vanta’s on-demand product demo to see how 7,000+ companies automate security and save hundreds of hours on audit prep. [Learn how to get compliant in weeks](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng9SOhcsNy3UZBcAZvHwbeE/JFQlsMO17Fae), not months - without slowing down your team.

 

💰 **VC Funds for Female Founders:**Berlin’s [Auxxo](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6vLwtrlX4zfDnxx1VYGWkZ0/7QEpWqGfi1ZR) just raised €26 million to invest exclusively in teams with at least one female founder. ❤️ **Passion vs. Money:**Earlier this week we asked our LinkedIn followers "Who do you think is more likely to succeed: Founders with a strong passion for their industry/product or founders with a strong drive to make money?" Here are the [results and comments](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Aw4yIIFFx0lIHXJ5KV29nG/DhocdNjjP3IF).

 

🌱 **GreenTech Innovators: **


- London-based [Sunsave](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Ij90VYbLQgX2RKRsDcHrPO/3jP3t-BTQwPp) banked €130 million to take solar mainstream with a zero-upfront subscription model. 
- Swiss startup [Jaipur Robotics](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7QWD2ioxQuMImb7af6jXZ1W/Ip82RP5Zx-nN) secured €161K to solve inefficiencies in waste-to-energy. 
- London’s [Fuse Energy](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7YJH4w5JWO24WkujRzqnGde/x6_IyvLUQEa4) raised an additional €8.5 million to build the world’s first renewable giant. 
 

🛡️ **GDPR Impact:** Yesterday, we asked our LinkedIn followers "Do you think GDPR had a positive impact on data privacy and data protection in Europe so far?" [The results](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7g6L79LfbrhqGuhsEsy2yFm/G1eyv5l-QIQB) might surprise you... :)

🎧 **EU-Startups Podcast:**This week we published two exciting episodes. In [Episode 128](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7vgTBZsNmp3NlEI9ofCYNU2/fkobxD4G0zqy), Wouter Durville (Co-founder & CEO of TestGorilla) shares how the company is making recruitment fairer, faster and more inclusive and in [Episode 127](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ83TXDn8jsIj9VO5IbYJo56A/5Y8lJ8jlVkXg), Antonio Escárzaga and David Cendón García from the EU-Startups editorial team explore the evolution of startup media, from the rise of AI-generated content to what makes a story stand out today.

body:
Hi Shubham,

 

Not everything with the label AI actually has "real AI" in it, and quite a bit of the AI-generated content (images, videos, audio, text) that is currently flooding the web can be misleading or even harmful in some cases... 

 

In the end, what today's AI tools are spitting out in terms of content is mainly based on human IP that was scraped from across the web and from millions of publicly available data sources. John Oliver, from the Last Week Tonight show recently shared [a funny and insightful roundup regarding AI content](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSz57aqxQDwjt4eorw9a/7NhghPBZg36Z), which I really enjoyed watching.

 

And here are some more updates and insights that might spark your interest. Not AI generated. Promised! :)

 

🏆 **Pitch Black returns to Malta:** The pitch competition "Pitch Black" by our partner from Malta Enterprise returns this October (20–24) with exciting pitches and a serious prize package of up to €350K in equity funding, mentorship, and more. Think your startup has what it takes? [Apply until the 17th of July](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSVaQZQBsGJ3hF1Jeg66/lAExD2aCssKX) and claim your spot in the spotlight.

 

💭 **Real AI or just marketing?**From smart washing machines to AI-labelled mice, the line between true intelligence and clever branding is getting blurry. This week, we [explored 5 real examples](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFS25jXzQKIfNVPNoRQ2c/HWmSvhgKWqy5) where smart marketing blurs the line between automation and true AI.

- Dutch startup [Dexter Energy](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng01R56LV7tENO17k6o0tve/hxhIBkZT74al) raised €23 million to scale its AI-powered forecasting and trade optimisation services for renewables and batteries. 
- Prague-based [TopK](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng1uQbbeTh7gPkKvuTIndsA/H9QoQFdEKC0X) secured €4.6 million to build an AI-native search engine tailored for enterprise use.

- London-based [Zango AI](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng7ZPB7ZPOp2WpIMPYn9rhi/OWv9pNw6_rsJ) emerged from stealth with €4 million to bring AI agents into financial compliance. 
- Dutch startup [Tibo Energy](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2ng9SOhcsNy3UZBcAZvHwbeE/K26PKFnsuyt8) secured €6 million to expand its AI-driven energy management platform. 
- French startup [BONX](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ6vLwtrlX4zfDnxx1VYGWkZ0/MfZ7ITY6IPTY) raised €7.3 million, aiming to become a market leader in AI-powered ERP systems for manufacturers.

💳 **FinTech Funding Rounds:**


- London-based [Ferovinum](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ7Ij90VYbLQgX2RKRsDcHrPO/plPJI94dkxWL) bottled €468 million to support global funding in the drinks trade.

🌿 **GreenTech Titans of Tomorrow: **


- Katowice-based startup [SR Robotics](https://4ntll.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/WCPzyXJTZ73AtvbXC92ZRaU3ySnsZC7e/YWhI1W4APGlK) raised €8.4 million to expand eco-friendly underwater solutions and help strengthen Europe’s energy security. 
- Dutch startup Dexter Energy raises €23 million to scale AI-powered forecasting and trade optimisation services for renewables and batteries
